events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Brock Nelson scored twice in a 1:12 span in the first period and sealed his fifth career hat trick with an empty-netter in the Colorado Avalanche's 4-1 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Nelson has hat trick in NHL-leading Avalanche's 4-1 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Matty Beniers and Berkly Catton scored 18 seconds apart in the third period, Joey Daccord made 27 saves and the Seattle Kraken beat the New Jersey Devils 4-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beniers, Catton score 18 seconds apart in 3rd period as Kraken beat Devils 4-2

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Stephen Halliday had two goals and an assist, Dylan Cozens also scored twice and the Ottawa Senators routed the road-weary Vegas Golden Knights 7-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Halliday, Cozens each score twice in Senators' 7-1 romp over road-weary Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Rookie Ben Kindel scored twice in the second period to lead the Penguins to a 3-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Sunday and a sweep of Pittsburgh's four-game western Canada trip.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Ben Kindel scores twice, leads Penguins to a 3-2 win over the Canucks

headlines.description: — Defenseman Tobias Bjornfot scored his first two goals this season — giving him just three over seven NHL seasons and 139 career games — and the Florida Panthers defeated the Chicago Blackhawks 5-1 on Sunday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Journeyman Bjornfot has his first 2-goal game, Panthers score 4 times in 3rd to beat Blackhawks 5-1

headlines.description: — Rookie Beckett Sennecke scored at 2:54 of overtime for his first NHL hat trick as the Anaheim Ducks rallied to beat the Calgary Flames 4-3 Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sennecke scores in OT for 1st NHL hat trick as Ducks rally to beat Flames 4-3
